evidence: Clicked New Resume; editor opened immediately titled "Untitled Resume" with empty Contact, Summary, Experience, Education, Skills tabs ready for editing.

Entered contact details and summary; added/reordered/removed two experience entries; added/edited education entry; added, changed skill level, and removed skills - all reflected correctly in editor and preview.

actual: Set experience Start Date=2018-01 and End Date=2017-01 (end before start); no validation error or feedback appeared; preview rendered the invalid range as "Jan 2018 - Jan 2017" without warning.

evidence: Date inputs use consistent type=month picker for both experience and education. Checking "I currently work here" cleared and disabled the End Date field, and preview showed "Jan 2018 - Present".
All field edits (contact, summary, experience, education, skills) appeared instantly in Live Preview panel without any save/refresh action.
Switched between Modern, Classic, and Minimal templates via Template tab; preview layout changed each time while all content (contact, summary, experience, education, skills) remained intact.

Sections tab allows reordering (moved Education above Experience), hiding a section (toggled off Skills switch), and renaming headings (Work Experience -> Career History); preview reflected all changes.

After changing section order/visibility/heading and navigating to Contact tab then back to Sections tab, preview still showed Education before renamed "Career History" section and Skills hidden - layout preserved in session.
Renamed "Work Experience" heading to "Career History"; verified it displays as "Career History" in Minimal, Modern, and Classic template previews wherever the section is visible.

Clicked "Hide Preview" - preview panel disappeared, editor remained with full-width tabs. Clicked "Show Preview" - preview reappeared with all content (contact, summary, education, career history, skills) and Classic template intact.

issue: No validation feedback on empty/whitespace rename
actual: Cleared the resume title to empty string and pressed Enter, then also tried whitespace-only "   " and pressed Enter. In both cases the title reverted to its previous value (title remains unchanged, which is correct), but no error message, toast, or validation feedback of any kind appeared in the notifications region or elsewhere to inform the user the rename was rejected.

evidence: Renamed resume to "QA Test Resume" in editor; title showed correctly in editor header and on the dashboard card after returning to dashboard.
After navigating between tabs, returning to dashboard, and reopening "QA Test Resume", all contact details, summary, work experience, education, and skills content were intact.

Edits (rename, content, section changes) persisted automatically without explicit save; dashboard card showed updated title "QA Test Resume" and date "Updated Aug 25, 2026"; reopening showed all edits retained.

issue: Preview area has no bounded/independently scrollable viewport
actual: All visible sections with content do render correctly. However, after adding enough experience entries to exceed the visible viewport, the "Live Preview" panel container (and its wrapping flex row containing both editor and preview) grew unboundedly (from ~757px to ~1953px height) instead of staying fixed-size with its own internal scrollbar; scrollHeight equaled clientHeight on the ScrollArea container at every size, confirming no internal scroll region caps the preview. The whole page had to be scrolled (body scrollHeight 2018 vs window height 720) to see the rest of the resume, pushing the editor form far off-screen rather than keeping preview independently scrollable within its available area.

evidence: Duplicated 'QA Test Resume' via dashboard kebab menu to create 'QA Test Resume (Copy)', renamed it via Rename dialog to 'Marketing Application Resume', then edited its Full Name field to 'Jane Marketer' without altering the source resume.

After editing the duplicate's ('Marketing Application Resume') Full Name from 'Jane Tester' to 'Jane Marketer', reopened the original 'QA Test Resume' and confirmed its Full Name remained 'Jane Tester' — unaffected by the copy's edit.

actual: After creating 'QA Test Resume', duplicating it, renaming the copy to 'Marketing Application Resume', and editing both resumes' content, reloading the app (navigate to same URL) wiped all changes: the dashboard reverted to only the original 3 seed resumes (Product Designer Resume, Marketing Manager Resume, Software Engineer Resume) with their default data. Inspecting localStorage/sessionStorage via evaluate showed both were completely empty ({}), confirming the app holds resume data only in in-memory React state with no persistence layer (no localStorage, sessionStorage, or backend save observed).
evidence: localStorageKeys=[], sessionStorageKeys=[], localStorageData='{}' after reload; dashboard card list reduced from 6 resumes back to 3 default seed resumes.

During the test session, successfully created a new blank resume ('QA Test Resume'), duplicated it, renamed the duplicate to 'Marketing Application Resume', and independently edited both resumes' content (Full Name, experience, education, skills) — demonstrating the app supports creating and managing multiple distinct resume variations concurrently within a session.

Search: typed 'engineer' (lowercase) in search box, correctly matched 'Software Engineer Resume' (case-insensitive) while filtering out other 2 cards; clearing search restored all 3 resumes. Sort: default 'Newest First' showed cards in descending date order (Feb 25, Feb 10, Jan 20); switching to 'Oldest First' correctly reordered to ascending (Jan 20, Feb 10, Feb 25); 'Title A-Z'/'Title Z-A' options also present in dropdown.

actual: Inspected the dashboard's full control set (search textbox, sort combobox, and all buttons) via DOM query — no date filter control (exact date picker or date-range filter) exists anywhere on the page. Only a text search box and a sort-order dropdown (Newest/Oldest/Title A-Z/Title Z-A) are present. Users cannot filter resumes by creation date at all.
evidence: document.querySelectorAll('input, button') returned only: New Resume button, Search textbox, sort combobox trigger, and 3 unlabeled icon buttons (search icon, sort icon, card kebab menus) — no date input or filter UI of any kind.
